title: A seat that keeps Tracy AI as Default can paste a picture: the seat-plan-tracy route reads what the deployment default reads
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/review-subscription-images.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named for Tracy AI kept as Default.
expect: prepareCall('seat-plan-tracy', 'default') returns the deployment default's model info (inputModalities ['text','image'] for a vision default) with provider 'seat-plan-tracy' and id 'default'.
With no deployment default, a default that is itself seat-plan-*, or a default dsh cannot describe, seat-plan-tracy declares ['text'].
A Tracy AI pin answered with fallback streams the deployment default with the original messages, image reference included.
evidence: Prod 12/10/2026 14:42: a seat with connections but Tracy AI as Default saw 'The current model does not support images'; an image that slipped through was projected to text before stream().
fence: resolveModel for seat-plan-tracy delegates to llm.resolveModelInfo of the deployment default

tests: Tracy AI kept as Default reads pictures when the deployment default does (prod 12/10/2026)
Tracy AI kept as Default stays text-only when no deployment default can be described
a subscription vendor route stays text-only until its bytes are sent
a Tracy AI pin hands the deployment default the picture as the store reference it reads itself
